g.text: Half of urban Balochistan earners make Rs 250,000 or less;
about 1 in 10 make Rs 540,000 or more
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Balochistan urban (n = 486). Weighted by hhweight. 0 earners outside Rs 10,000-10,000,000 excluded.
